描述_EN: many grave goods copied objects from daily life but in reduced size, such as this figure of a woman musician. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware.
描述_ZN: 许多墓葬用品都是模仿日常生活中的物品，但尺寸缩小了，比如这个女乐师的形象。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。
